target_paper.title: BADGE: BADminton report Generation and Evaluation with LLM

generation.parameters: one user message; no temperature / max_tokens / top_p / seed, exactly as code/generation/GPT-4.py and code/evaluation/*.py -> API default temperature 1.0
generation.prompts: prompt/generation/CSV+CoT.txt ({CSV} <- CSV/<game>/CSV.txt) and prompt/evaluation/<criterion>.txt ({Badminton Report} <- report), read from the repo at run time
generation.battery: stage 1 writer 30 calls, stage 2 judge 480 calls, 3 seeds, score parser: bare integer, else the last '<criterion> [Score][:] <n>' with markdown bold tolerated, 1-10 enforced, otherwise missing

vs_published_8_825.why: the original is inside the match-bootstrap CI and GPT-4 >= GPT-3.5 > human (GPT-4 8.750, CI [8.625, 8.867]; GPT-3.5 8.261; human 7.900; original 8.825)

vs_released_recomputed_8_40.why: the LLM-over-human ordering holds but the original is outside the CI (GPT-4 8.750, CI [8.625, 8.867]; GPT-3.5 8.261; human 7.900; original 8.4)

vs_published_8_825.why: the original is inside the match-bootstrap CI and GPT-4 >= GPT-3.5 > human (GPT-4 8.761, CI [8.625, 8.875]; GPT-3.5 8.261; human 7.900; original 8.825)

vs_released_recomputed_8_40.why: the LLM-over-human ordering holds but the original is outside the CI (GPT-4 8.761, CI [8.625, 8.875]; GPT-3.5 8.261; human 7.900; original 8.4)

results.judged_by: automatic rule per ANALYSIS_PLAN section 1 as the card instantiates it: survived = the published 8.825 lies inside the match-level bootstrap 95% CI of the re-run GPT-4 row AND GPT-4 >= GPT-3.5 > human; partial = ordering holds but level or CI does not; dead = human reports scored at or above the LLM-written ones; human double-coding pending
results.note: the original is inside the match-bootstrap CI and GPT-4 >= GPT-3.5 > human (GPT-4 8.750, CI [8.625, 8.867]; GPT-3.5 8.261; human 7.900; original 8.825)

reproducibility_frictions_observed: the released judge outputs do not rebuild Table 2's GPT-4 row: our parser gives 8.400 (consistency 8.00 with released item scores 10, 4, 8, 10, unparseable, 9, 3, 9, 9, 10) against the published 8.825, while the GPT-3.5 row (8.625) reproduces exactly and the human row reaches 7.925 once one judge reply that renames the criterion ('- Excitiveness: 6') is counted
the repository ships no score parser and no table-building script; the parser above is a documented pipeline paraphrase, not a prompt change
no decoding parameter is set anywhere in the repository, so writer and judge both run at temperature 1.0 on n = 10 matches; the published GPT-4 - GPT-3.5 gap of 0.20 is inside that noise

path mismatch in the repository: the generation scripts write generation/<game>/<model>/ while the evaluation scripts read report/<game>/<model>/, and evaluation/ stores the report directory as 'csv+CoT.txt' for 9 of the 10 games and 'CSV+CoT.txt' for the tenth
the GPT-3.5 writer arm (gpt-3.5-turbo-0125, shut down 2026-03-26) cannot be regenerated; its released reports and the human reports are judged as fixed inputs
Table 3 (human raters) and the r = 0.333 correlation cannot be re-executed
the 10 human-written reports are third-party news text: they stay inside the L1 archive as prompt inputs only
